72 ## 2. The converged method (after the adversarial loop)
73 ### ELEVATE protocol (the magic) — stateless SKILL.md steps, run AFTER the diagnose core, gated by the firing gate
74 **SITUATE (commission researchPrime):** S0 ABSTRACT the artifact's core challenge to a domain-neutral pattern
75 (Gandalf-only — the author can't abstract their own framing) → S1 commission researchPrime to find the field
76 where that pattern is a solved, mature problem (moderate-to-far distance; exclude the artifact's own field) →
77 S2 structure-map (≥2 relational correspondences, answer-first) → **route the CORRESPONDENCE CLAIM itself
78 through a SEPARATE-origin refuter** (find the strongest disanalogy) → outside-view base rate of Y in its home field.
79 
80 **ANTICIPATE (Gandalf owns — bounded premortem on a sound artifact):** "N months later this sound artifact hit
81 a wall — what coming problem did the author miss?"; each anticipation asserts a problem NOT YET PRESENT (a
82 future-state condition + enabling assumption — machine-checkably distinct from a present-tense diagnose
83 finding); subject_cardinality==1; NO counterfactual-cost/regret pricing (that is Crucible's Oranges → commission
84 Crucible). Hold a conservative/aggressive SET when an anticipation hinges on an unknowable.
85 
86 **SCORE + LABEL (honest, never a kill-filter):** dual-axis value-if-true × groundedness (NIH); tier = the
87 refutation OUTCOME, earned by an INDEPENDENT named-defeater refutation (never a self-score):
88 - **GROUNDED** *(requires a CROSS-FAMILY refuter that could not land the named defeater + a researchPrime-
89   verified basis)*
90 - **PROMISING-BUT-UNVERIFIED** *(a same-family refuter could not land the defeater — a frame-bounded lower
91   bound; THE TOP TIER ACHIEVABLE ON A SINGLE-FAMILY HOST)*
92 - **SPECULATIVE** *(not refuted, no independent refutation ran)* · **REFUTED** *(defeater landed — DROP; the
93   only drop condition)*.
94
